blocks.text: Job 22 is part of the sustained debate between Job and his friends. They had first sat with him in silence, but their counsel increasingly treats suffering as proof of wrongdoing and presses accusations that Job rejects. Read Eliphaz’s charges here as part of that disputed argument, not as an established account of Job. Elsewhere Job is remembered for endurance through suffering; that description can mean persistence across the story and does not require silent acceptance of abuse or rule out seeking protection.
